title: Adding a note needs View on that kind of record
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  2. A teammate at the same location to tag, User B (e.g. "Dana Lee"); they are listed under Settings -> Staff.
  3. A work order at this location: Work Orders -> New Work Order, select a customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair"), save.
  4. A part sale at this location: Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, select the customer.
  5. Create the test role: Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create custom role -> choose a template (e.g. "Service Advisor") -> Apply; untick Work Orders -> View and leave Part Sales -> View ticked; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST Part sales only" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> open User B -> Edit Staff Member -> Role -> pick "ZZAUTOTEST Part sales only" -> save. User B must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
  6. A second teammate, User C (e.g. "Sam Ortiz"). Create the test role: Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create custom role -> choose a template (e.g. "Service Advisor") -> Apply; leave Work Orders -> View ticked and untick Part Sales -> View; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST Work orders only" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> open User C -> Edit Staff Member -> Role -> pick "ZZAUTOTEST Work orders only" -> save. User C must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as User B (Part Sales -> View only). Try to open the work order and add a note to it or to one of its lines.
  2. Still as User B, open the part sale and add a note (New Note, type a message, save).
  3. Sign in as User C (Work Orders -> View only). Add a note to the work order.
  4. Still as User C, try to open the part sale and add a note.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • User B cannot add a note to the work order or its lines.
  • User B can add a note to the part sale.
  • User C can add a note to the work order.
  • User C cannot add a note to the part sale: Work Orders -> View is not enough for a part sale.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10253 (S10, Who can do what); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297) as edited 2 October 2026, S10; read 5 Oct 2026. Source-verified 5 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R3: “Adding a note to a work order or work order line requires 'Work Orders → View'.”
  • S10-R4: “Adding a note to a Part Sale requires 'Part Sales → View'.”
